content.title: KOTAX: An integrated corporate disclosure corpus linked to a financial and tax panel of Korean listed firms
content.abstract: The financial condition and business environment of a firm are difficult to fully capture using only the quantitative figures presented in financial statements. Business reports and audit reports contain important information that complements structured financial data—such as business structure, risk factors, accounting policies, management judgments, and audit opinions—in the form of text and tables. However, existing financial and tax panels and corporate disclosure document corpora are generally provided separately, and publicly available data resources that directly link quantitative data
